description: User-facing text keyed by locale (D-069 item 15, plan v3.1 L1): which locales exist, which one every text entry must carry, and what the text check reads.

l10n.default_locale.description: The locale every text entry must carry and the one a reader falls back to; it must be one of l10n.locales.

l10n.locales.description: Locales a text entry (x-text) may be keyed by; English only for now (D-069 item 15). Adding a locale is a reviewed registry change.

l10n.scoped_exports.description: path:identifier of each exported constant of a shared D-063 catalog that has migrated: its initializer must read the text catalog, never spell a string literal. A name that no longer exists in the file is refused, so the list cannot rot.

l10n.scoped_files.description: Component files whose every user-visible string must come from the text catalog: JSX text, string children and the l10n.visible_attributes with a literal are refused. Enforced only where text has migrated; a unit adds its files here when it migrates in U4 (P-05), so no file is edited twice.

l10n.text_owner.description: The registry owner whose parameters are all user-facing text: every entry of config/registry/<owner>.json must be x-text, and an x-text entry may live nowhere else.

l10n.visible_attributes.description: JSX attributes whose string value a reader sees or hears; a literal value in a scoped file is refused.

l10n.visible_min_letters.description: Letters a JSX string needs before it counts as user-visible text (a lone punctuation or symbol is markup).
